title: Context card
description: One piece of work joined across agent sessions, git, pull requests, tickets and messages: what it is, where it stands, what is left and how to pick it up. A card has two parts. 'remote' and the top-level fields hold what any reader can fetch again from a server (git remote, GitHub, Jira, Slack). 'local' holds what works only on the machine that made the card (folder paths, the command that resumes a session); a shared card has no 'local'. The summary is written by a model from the sessions and dated; everything else is data.

id.description: Stable id of the work, e.g. t:ABC-12 (ticket), b:<repo>@<branch> (branch) or s:<agent>:<session>

locality.description: local: made for the machine it was made on, with 'local'; shared: fit to send, with no local paths, session ids or secrets

value.description: latent: defined, no material work; conscious: worked on now; subconscious: not done and quiet; etched: done; forgotten: unfinished and left

origin.description: Who made the card, and with what

by.description: the git user name of the person whose work it is

thread.description: Set when the card is published to a shared space: the thread it updates

summary.description: Written by a model from the sessions, as of 'as_of'. A sentence that the live state contradicts ends with [outdated: what is true now].

waiting_on_you.description: The question that the last session asked and that is not answered, in its own words when it can be

since_last_session.description: What git and GitHub show after the last session: merges, pushes

outdated.description: Summary claims that the live state contradicts, with what is true now

last_words.description: The end of the last session's last message; in a shared card, without local paths or secrets

remote.description: Where the work lives on servers: enough to get it and its live state again from anywhere

git.description: the clone URL of the remote (origin)

head.description: the commit the branch was at when the card was made

pushed.description: true when every commit of the branch is on the remote, so head can be fetched

shared_branch.description: a PR of a branch that other work also uses

links.description: Messages, pages and documents about the work (a Slack thread, a Notion page), from Pensieve's connections

attachments.description: What the work made that people open: Claude artifacts, published pages, designs

handoff.description: How someone on another machine picks the work up

next.description: the next step: the question that waits, or what is left

start.description: shell commands that get the work, e.g. gh pr checkout 12

refresh.description: commands that get the live state the card was made from

files.description: The main files the work changed, relative to the repo

local.description: Only on the machine that made the card. A shared card has none of it.

resume.description: the shell command that resumes the last session

files.description: files outside the repo that the sessions made
